task_summary: Resolved layout collision and text truncation in expanded and collapsed sidebar under text zoom (100%, 125%, 150%) by replacing hardcoded pixel widths with scalable relative dimensions (w-72 min-w-[16.5rem] expanded, w-20 min-w-[5rem] collapsed), centering the collapse toggle button and icon rail, adding min-w-0 on flex containers and flex-1 min-w-0 truncate on label text with accessible browser title tooltips, enforcing shrink-0 on icons and badges, and isolating vertical scrolling with min-h-0 overflow-y-auto on the navigation element.

playwright_visual_audit.125_percent_zoom: verified light & dark desktop (zero truncation, centered toggle button)

post_mortem.lesson: Hardcoded pixel widths (e.g. w-[260px] or w-[76px]) do not scale when font sizes are magnified via document.documentElement.style.fontSize or browser zoom, causing text that needs 16-18rem of space to be squeezed and truncated. Additionally, flex items inside a flex container without min-w-0 refuse to shrink, causing layout overflow.
post_mortem.learned: Using scalable rem-based widths (w-72 / min-w-[16.5rem] and w-20 / min-w-[5rem]) allows the navigation containers to scale proportionally with font zoom. In collapsed state, unmounting the brand container completely and using justify-center px-2 ensures the toggle button and all icons stay centered on the vertical axis without clipping against borders.
post_mortem.prevention: Rule 110: Always use relative rem-based dimensions for navigation containers, apply min-w-0 to flex parents, flex-1 min-w-0 truncate with title={label} to text spans, shrink-0 to icons and badges, and min-h-0 overflow-y-auto to scrollable column areas.
post_mortem.runbook: Run targeted test npm test --workspace=client -- src/components/layouts/Sidebar.test.jsx, run Playwright visual audit across 100%, 125%, 150% zoom in Light & Dark modes, and verify endpoint parity.
checklist: Sidebar width uses relative units (w-72 min-w-[16.5rem], w-20 min-w-[5rem])
Icons and status badges enforce shrink-0
Text labels enforce flex-1 min-w-0 truncate with title attribute
Collapsed rail centers toggle button and icons with justify-center and px-0/px-2
Navigation container has min-h-0 overflow-y-auto to prevent pushing bottom actions off-screen
Visual screenshots inspected across zoom levels
